The day's crypto news is a mixture of market positioning, fund flows, policy updates, and company decisions. The headlines below are worth reading for the detail behind them, not just the reaction on a price chart.

What is moving the conversation

Citi plans to launch bitcoin custody for institutional clients later this year. The Wall Street bank plans to let clients hold bitcoin alongside traditional assets through its new Custody+ platform. Readers should check the original report before treating the headline as a confirmed change in the market.

Crypto’s easy-money era is ending in a wave of failures. Inflated valuations and weak business models are driving crypto’s shakeout, Global Settlement Network CEO Ryan Kirkley says. Readers should check the original report before treating the headline as a confirmed change in the market.

Cash App's crypto support expands beyond bitcoin and USDC via MoonPay. Eligible Cash App users will be able to use their balances to purchase digital assets offered by MoonPay, which include ether, solana and stablecoin USDT. Readers should check the original report before treating the headline as a confirmed change in the market.

Visa looking for new stablecoin settlement partner after BVNK sale to Mastercard. Visa’s request for product (RFP) talks about the need to support a range of stablecoins. Readers should check the original report before treating the headline as a confirmed change in the market.

Ethereum’s next upgrade breaks the '21,000 gas' rule wallets rely on. Sending ETH to a brand-new address will cost more than sending to an existing one, and software built around a flat fee will get the sum wrong. Readers should check the original report before treating the headline as a confirmed change in the market.

The 'crack' in the energy market is wider than ever. Bitcoin might feel it.. Your day-ahead look for Aug. 18 2026 Readers should check the original report before treating the headline as a confirmed change in the market.

Market context

Bitcoin is around $64,280 with a +1.13% 24-hour move, while Ether is around $1,898.49 with a -0.08% move. Those figures are a snapshot, not a forecast. The useful question is whether the move is supported by spot demand, volume, and a clear change in the news.

When the market is quiet, leverage and liquidity can matter as much as direction. A small headline can move price quickly when traders are positioned too closely on one side.

What to watch next

  • New ETF creations and redemptions.
  • Futures open interest and funding rates.
  • Fresh regulatory text or official statements.
  • Security warnings, outages, or custody changes.
  • Whether the reported developments become live products rather than announcements.

The fairest reading today is cautious attention. There are real developments in the industry, but none should be stretched into a guaranteed market direction.

 Crypto Today: Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP Edge Higher Despite Returning ETF Outflows

Bitcoin, Ethereum, and XRP are trading higher today, defying a renewed wave of outflows from digital asset exchange-traded funds (ETFs).
